# Project Instructions

- This project is a frontend-only React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and React Router application.
- Keep it local for now; do not deploy or introduce backend services, databases, authentication, admin, ordering, payment, AI, MCP, RAG, or external APIs.
- Do not build the complete menu UI until explicitly requested.
- Prefer simple typed modules and the existing source folder architecture.
- Run `npm run build` after implementation changes.
